approach: Static recompilation of the 32-bit ARM executables (a32recomp lifter, built on suyu's recompiler mode), with an NVN to Vulkan replacement renderer
notes: Exports a native executable from the user's own game dump; no game files are distributed. Working: 100% code coverage, native render resolution, ultrawide and frame rate options, in-game F10 menu, drag-and-drop mod loading (Forge), crossplay rooms (RyuLdn). Next: performance work (GPU is close to suyu's efficiency; loading is already faster than suyu thanks to unpacked game archives), and modding tools, which live in Forge. Parts of this project were written with AI assistance; see docs/a32recomp/AI_DISCLOSURE.md.
